name: micro-fe-prototype
description: Two micro frontend integration strategies (shared React singleton vs independent React versions) running side by side

scripts.serve: concurrently -k -P -n compare,o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2,o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c cyan,blue,blue,blue,yellow,yellow,yellow "pnpm --filter compare dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @o1/app1 preview" "pnpm --filter @o1/app2 preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/app1 preview" "pnpm --filter @o2/app2 preview"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -P -n compare,o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2,o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c cyan,blue,blue,blue,yellow,yellow,yellow "pnpm --filter compare dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/app1 dev" "pnpm --filter @o1/app2 dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/app1 dev" "pnpm --filter @o2/app2 dev"
